payload.reason: The evidence indicates that deep learning models, specifically LSTM and GRU with Attention, outperform other methods in offensive language identification tasks based on their F1 scores and recall metrics.

claims.text: LSTM and GRU with Attention are the best performing models for offensive language identification, achieving an F1-macro score of 0.89.
Linear SVM is the best classical machine learning model for offensive language detection, achieving a score of 0.80.
SGDC yields the best recall score for the Offensive class among classical models, at 0.61.
